proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
proposed.text: Karen comes back to New York when Dex escapes and gets Frank Castle to protect Matt. Together they dig through Foggy's old case files and learn that Fisk's Red Hook port is a free port.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's old friend, whom she comes home to protect after Dex escapes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's old friend, who comes home to protect him and finds Foggy's files with him.

changes.evidence: After Foggy's death Karen moves to San Francisco (Born Again S1#1). In S1#9 'Straight to Hell' she returns as soon as she hears of Dex's escape, asks Castle to protect Matt, and she and Matt find Foggy's files showing Red Hook is a free port. Their reunion has no stage; stage 5 (Born Again S2) currently carries it in its text ('she comes back'), which could then be trimmed to the S2 events (hiding out at Josie's, building the resistance, rekindled romance).

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#6
proposed.text: Ellison apologizes to Karen for blocking her Fisk story and backs her interview with Jasper Evans at the Bulletin.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's editor, who apologizes and backs her Fisk story.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ellison's reporter, whose Fisk story he comes to back.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#6 'The Devil You Know': after ordering her off Fisk in S3#3, Ellison tells Karen 'I owe you an apology... Lead on' and sits in on her interview with Jasper Evans at the Bulletin, which Poindexter then attacks. A clear turn between the S3#3 clash and the S3#7 firing.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#12
proposed.text: Ellison hugs Karen when she comes out of hiding, and he calls the press conference where she tells the city that Nadeem is testifying against Fisk.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Karen's old editor, who takes her back and calls a press conference for her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The reporter he fired, for whom he calls a press conference against Fisk.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#12 'One Last Shot': Ellison, who fired Karen in S3#7, hugs her at his hot-dog stand ('Welcome back'), agrees to call a press conference, and stands beside her as she denounces Fisk. A reconciliation with no stage; the S3#13 stage only covers the video release.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#5
proposed.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem questions Karen Page about Matt Murdock, and she tries to steer him toward Fisk's crimes instead.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An FBI agent on Fisk's detail who questions Karen about Matt.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who tries to steer Nadeem toward Fisk.

changes.evidence: The connection starts well before S3#11: in S3#5 'The Perfect Game' Nadeem questions Karen and Foggy about Matt and both try to point him at Fisk; in S3#6 Foggy sets up a meeting between Nadeem and Karen at the Bulletin; in S3#7 she fails to convince him the attacker was not the real Daredevil. Kind 'rival' is my reading of that stretch.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: After Nadeem is killed, Karen releases the video he recorded before his death, which exposes Fisk's crimes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An FBI agent who turns on Fisk, whose dying video Karen releases.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who releases Nadeem's dying video to expose Fisk.

changes.evidence: Dex kills Nadeem at the end of S3#12 (no stage records the death), and in S3#13 'A New Napkin' Karen distributes Nadeem's video dying declaration on social media, exposing Fisk.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#3
proposed.text: After her sting on the Punisher goes wrong, District Attorney Samantha Reyes brushes off Karen Page and Foggy Nelson and threatens to blame their firm for the mess.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The district attorney who threatens to blame Karen's firm for her failed sting.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A legal assistant Reyes threatens after her sting fails.

changes.evidence: They meet over Grotto's deal in S2#2, and in S2#3 'New York's Finest' Karen and Foggy confront Reyes about the disastrous sting; she shows no sympathy, says Nelson and Murdock are out of their league and threatens to blame them. The connection starts here, not at S2#10.

now.title: Daredevil S2#10
now.text: Karen Page uncovers Samantha Reyes's role in the cover-up around the Castle family's deaths.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The district attorney whose cover-up Karen uncovers.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The reporter who uncovers Reyes's role in the Castle cover-up.

proposed.text: Samantha Reyes admits to Karen Page and her friends that her own sting led to the Castle family's deaths, and moments later she is shot dead in front of them.

changes.evidence: In S2#10 'The Man in the Box' Reyes herself confirms to Nelson, Murdock and Page that her office ran the sting that killed Castle's family, then is gunned down in front of them. The stage leaves out her death (a death is a stage).

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#4
now.text: Fisk strikes back by raiding her law office and freezing its accounts. She works with Matt to find witnesses who can prove Fisk's crimes and remove him from office.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor who raids Kirsten's office and whom she works to remove.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer whose office Fisk raids, who hunts witnesses against him.

proposed.text: Fisk strikes back by raiding her law office and freezing its accounts. She helps Karen record the testimony of a witness who can prove Fisk's crimes.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#4 'Gloves Off': Matt is in hiding; it is Karen who convinces McDuffie to record the testimony of Christofi Savva, the Northern Star's first mate. Matt is not the one she works with here.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
proposed.text: Matt comes out of hiding to defend Karen at her trial beside Kirsten, and Fisk's task force attacks them both outside the courthouse.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Kirsten's law partner, who defends Karen beside her at trial.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's law partner, beside whom he defends Karen at trial.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#7 'The Hateful Darkness': Murdock comes out of hiding to serve as Page's counsel alongside McDuffie; after the first day the AVTF attacks Murdock and McDuffie in the courthouse parking lot. A new alliance after the only stage (S1#1).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
proposed.text: When Hunter and Bobbi are held after the Russia mission, Coulson offers to break them out, but they choose to be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D., and he sends them off with a spy's goodbye.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The director who lets Hunter go when he is disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal agent who chooses to be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D.

changes.evidence: AoS S3#13 'Parting Shot': Coulson enters their cell and offers an EMP escape; Hunter and Bobbi refuse and are disavowed, cutting all contact with S.H.I.E.L.D.; Coulson and the team buy them drinks in a spy's goodbye. Hunter's service under Coulson ends here with no stage. (Kind kept as boss; the owner may prefer friend.)

now.title: Daredevil S1#12
now.text: Leland Owlsley and Madame Gao arrange for Vanessa to be poisoned at a fundraiser, hoping to pull her away from Fisk. She survives.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fisk's love, whom Leland helps poison to pull her from Fisk.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Wilson's money man, who has Vanessa poisoned at a fundraiser.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#10
proposed.text: Leland Owlsley and Madame Gao arrange for Vanessa to be poisoned at Fisk's fundraiser, and Leland hands her the poisoned champagne.

changes.evidence: The poisoning happens at Fisk's charity gala in S1#10 'Nelson v. Murdock' (Owlsley meets Gao to plan it and offers Vanessa the glass), not S1#12. 'She survives' is only learned in S1#11, so it is dropped from an S1#10 stage.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#13
proposed.text: Fitz and Jemma trust Piper to guard the module hiding their daughter, and in return they bring back her best friend Davis.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who guards the module hiding Fitz's daughter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who trusts Piper with his daughter and brings Davis back for her.

changes.evidence: AoS S7#13 'What We're Fighting For': Fitz, Simmons and Enoch appear on Piper's Quinjet, have her and Flint guard the Containment Module holding Alya, and in return Fitz and Simmons bring Davis back for her.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#7
proposed.text: Luke pulls Mariah and her daughter out of the burning house Bushmaster leaves them in, and agrees to keep her alive until Harlem is safe from him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's rival for Harlem, whom he saves from a fire and protects from Bushmaster.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Mariah's rival for Harlem, who saves her from a fire and protects her.

changes.evidence: LC S2#7-#9: Cage carries Dillard out of the fire (S2#7), and in S2#8 tells her he will keep her alive until Harlem is safe from Bushmaster; he guards her at the precinct and the Rand building where she agrees to testify (S2#9). A clear enemies-to-reluctant-allies turn with no stage.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#12
proposed.text: Luke tells Mariah he will no longer protect her, and he and Misty watch as she is arrested.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's rival for Harlem, whom he stops protecting before her arrest.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Mariah's rival for Harlem, who stops protecting her.

changes.evidence: LC S2#12 'Can't Front on Me': Cage visits Dillard and tells her he will no longer protect her; at the end she is taken into custody while Cage and Knight watch. Ends the truce above.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#13
proposed.text: When Luke takes over Harlem's Paradise to keep crime in check, Misty calls him a dictator and warns that she will arrest him if he crosses the line.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who warns Luke she will arrest him if he crosses the line.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A man Misty warns she will arrest once he takes over Harlem's Paradise.

changes.evidence: LC S2#13 'They Reminisce Over You': Knight meets Cage at Harlem's Paradise, argues he is being a dictator and warns she will arrest him if he does wrong. Allies turn to wary rivals with no stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
proposed.text: Mr. Charles lets Luke Cage go home to his family, putting Dex in his place.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The CIA man who recruits Luke, then lets him go home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A CIA recruit Mr. Charles lets go home, taking Dex in his place.

changes.evidence: Born Again S2#8 'The Southern Cross': Luke turns up at Alias Investigations and tells Jessica the CIA let him return to his family because Mr. Charles recruited Bullseye/Dex in his stead. An off-screen turn stated on screen; no stage records Luke's release.

now.title: Luke Cage S1#6
now.text: Detective Rafael Scarfe is corrupt, but after Cottonmouth shoots him, Luke protects him so his evidence can reach the police.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A corrupt detective with evidence for the police. Luke protects him so it gets there.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Protects Scarfe so Scarfe's evidence can reach the police.

proposed.text: Detective Rafael Scarfe is corrupt, but after Cottonmouth shoots him, Luke protects him so his evidence can reach the police. Scarfe dies of his wounds on the way.

changes.evidence: LC S1#6 'Suckas Need Bodyguards': Cage and Temple try to get Scarfe to 1 Police Plaza, but he dies of his injuries before getting there. The stage leaves out his death (a death is a stage).

proposed.title: Luke Cage S1#10
proposed.text: Luke finds Reva's recorded notes and learns she was feeding Seagate's secret experiment program information on him as its best subject.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Luke's late wife, who secretly reported on him to Seagate's experimenters.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Reva's husband, whom she secretly studied for Seagate's experimenters.

changes.evidence: LC S1#10 'Take It Personal': going through Burstein's files, Cage and Temple find Reva's recordings and learn she knew about Rackham's fights and was assessing Lucas as a test subject for Burstein's procedure. A clear betrayal revealed after the S1#4 stage, with no stage.
